h5_note: A recursive search found no .h5 or .hdf5 volumes. The local release is NRRD (lgemri.nrrd image, laendo.nrrd cavity label). lawall.nrrd is the wall and is not the binary cavity target.

axis_order.nrrd_sizes: X Y Z, X fastest on disk
axis_order.array_and_model_axes: axis 0 = X = D, axis 1 = Y = H, axis 2 = Z = W
axis_order.prediction_restore: predictions stay in (X, Y, Z); no axis transpose is applied at save time

patch_axis_order: patch_size is [D, H, W] = [X, Y, Z]
normalization: per-case z-score of nonzero raw voxels; all-zero or zero-variance nonzero region -> zeros
resample: none; geometry is the original voxel grid
spacing_note: Every inspected header has space directions (1,0,0) (0,1,0) (0,0,1) and no space units. ASD and HD95 are reported in voxels. The challenge paper's 0.625 mm figure is not encoded in this copy and is not applied.
